title: Organisation identity (research candidate)
reason:
Depth: focused. Confidence high in research distinction, not accepted mapping. Broad purposeful group; legal status not implied. Public dataset coverage/rights require separate discovery. Possible current core comparison: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/organization?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97; unresolved scope/representation match.

Phase 2 ACCEPTED: Accepted reuse of core organization; this is concept/role reuse, not raw-value or cross-dataset identity equivalence. Source-local person, customer, employee, supplier, store and business-entity IDs have no cross-demo or real-world identity. Customer/supplier/employer/operator are roles; organisation, legal entity, site and registration differ. A native PK/FK supports only its declared source relationship. Alternate unique names/GUIDs are source-scoped; names are not LEI/ROR/ORCID or a portable person key.
practical_value: Broad purposeful group; legal status not implied.
showcase_value: Contextual graph/map/time-series opportunity; practical compatibility remains prerequisite.
